subject: Next steps: Silverpine evaluation (3-week POC proposal)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@silverpine.ai>, Tom Fletcher <tom.fletcher@silverpine.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Next steps: Silverpine evaluation (3-week POC proposal)

Hi Samira / Tom —

Great to meet the team today. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we have alignment on goals, timeline, and ownership. I captured this into a short outline (attached: redwood_poc_outline_v1.pdf). High level:

Objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference can serve Silverpine’s real-time summarization pipeline at <200ms median token latency and 99.5% request success during business hours for a 2x concurrent-user baseline.

Proposed POC (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff & environment access (1 day)
   - Provide sample dataset (anonymized) + expected summary length distribution
   - Exchange IP allowlist and temporary API keys
2) Week 1 — Integration + baseline run
   - One integration engineer from Silverpine + Redwood engineer (Monica)
   - Baseline metrics (latency, throughput, token cost) on a 1k-request sample set
3) Week 2 — Stress & failure modes
   - Load to 3x baseline, simulate network variance, measure fallbacks/cost
4) Week 3 — Acceptance & handoff
   - Acceptance test run, handoff checklist, model/config recommendations

Success criteria (pass/fail signals):
- Median end-to-end latency < 200ms for 95% of requests on the baseline set
- Per-token cost within 1.5x target (TBD)
- No data persistence beyond session (we will use ephemeral KV cache)
- Integration completeness: API calls implemented + basic error handling in client

Ownership:
- Redwood: Monica (integration lead), Ben (billing/ops contact)
- Silverpine: Samira (product lead), Tom (platform lead)

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the success criteria and any additional constraints (e.g., retention, logging)
- Share the anonymized sample payloads and the completed security questionnaire (if you want us to pre-fill config hints)
- Kickoff call — can we target Wed Dec 2 or Thu Dec 3 for a 30-min kickoff?

Thanks — attaching the short outline. Happy to tighten criteria if you have stricter SLOs.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood_poc_outline_v1.pdf (3 pages)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@silverpine.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Fletcher <tom.fletcher@silverpine.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps: Silverpine evaluation (3-week POC proposal)

Thanks Rishi — good recap and appreciate the clear plan. A few quick notes / asks from our side:

1) Security questionnaire — attaching our standard questionnaire. Can you have your security engineer fill the "data residency" and "key management" sections? We flagged the SOC2 and encryption questions as priority. (attachment: silverpine_security_questionnaire.pdf)
2) Cost target — our finance recommends cost at or under $0.004/token for batch summarization workloads. For streaming/low-latency path we can accept up to $0.007/token during the POC as long as we get final config that reduces it post-POC.
3) Sample data — we'll share a 500-doc anonymized set by EOD.
4) Kickoff — Dec 3 (Thu) 11:00am PT works for Tom and me. Can you send calendar invite?

Also, one ask: we run strict request logging and need an audit log for all API calls during the POC. Can Redwood expose per-request trace ids and a CSV export?

On the success criteria you listed: the latency target is aggressive for our current on-prem pipeline but aligns with the value. If Redwood can show a plan for KV caching and prefix caching to hit the 200ms target that would be helpful.

—Samira
VP Product — Silverpine AI
samira.khan@silverpine.ai

Attachments: silverpine_security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@silverpine.ai>, Tom Fletcher <tom.fletcher@silverpine.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps: Silverpine evaluation (3-week POC proposal)

Thanks Samira — great items. Quick responses below and notes on who will own what.

- Security questionnaire: Monica will fill the data residency + KMS sections and return a completed PDF by EOD tomorrow. Monica, looping you in.
- Cost target: Ben, please confirm whether we can meet $0.004/token in a 3-week POC (likely with quantized model variant + batch path for large docs) and provide a short estimate of expected token units for the 500-doc sample.
- Audit logs / traces: Yes — we can expose per-request trace ids and provide CSV exports. We'll also enable request-level metadata (timestamp, route, model_id, latency_ms). Note these logs will be available for the POC retention window (30 days) unless you configure otherwise.
- KV/prefix caching: Monica will propose a cache configuration for the sample distribution; we'll include recommended TTLs and hit-rate expectations in the kickoff deck.

Action owners:
- Monica Patel (Redwood): security questionnaire, cache config, integration guide
- Ben Carter (Redwood): cost estimate & billing contact
- Samira (Silverpine): provide sample payloads + confirm kickoff time
- Tom (Silverpine): share any port/IP constraints for allowlist

I'll send a calendar invite for Dec 3 11:00am PT and a short kickoff agenda.

Rishi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@silverpine.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps: Silverpine evaluation (3-week POC proposal)

Samira — quick note on cost and kickoff readiness.

- Cost: based on the sample profile you described (500 docs, avg 1.2k tokens input, 200 tokens summary), if we use a int8-quantized variant and a mixed streaming+batch path I estimate ~ $0.0036/token effective for the POC (above assumptions: 40% batchable tokens, 60% streaming). I can provide a line-item calc prior to kickoff.
- Token estimate for the 500-doc set: ~ 700k input tokens, ~100k output tokens.
- We'll provision a small Dedicated pool for the POC to hit latency SLOs; that will keep variability low.

Request: Monica / Rishi — when you send the invite, please include the shared Drive folder (linked above) and the kickoff agenda with the 30-min breakdown: 0-5 intro, 5-10 access & credentials, 10-20 integration checklist, 20-30 acceptance criteria & next steps.

Happy to join the call and run the short perf checklist.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference

Attachments referenced: line-item-costs.xlsx (will attach before kickoff)
